appearance.heading: Theme
appearance.hint: Dark is the design target for video work; light is fully supported.

zoom.heading: Interface zoom
zoom.hint: Scales the whole interface on top of your system text size. Ctrl + and Ctrl − work anywhere; Ctrl 0 resets.

language.heading: Language
language.hint: The language of the app's interface.

defaults.hint: Starting values for new videos — every field can still be changed per video.
defaults.formatHint: The same controls as Home's prompt row; live changes on Home overwrite this baseline.
defaults.voiceHint: Narrator used when a video doesn't specify one.
defaults.modelHint: Used when you create the final video. "Auto" follows the hardware recommendation; custom models appear here once added.

providers.heading: Cloud providers
providers.hint: Bring your own keys: they live in your OS keychain, go only to your engine, and are never sent to us.
providers.noKeychain: No OS keychain available — keys are stored obfuscated only.

models.heading: Model library
models.hint: Download more local models any time — jobs pick them up immediately.

storage.hint: Everything LocalCut AI keeps on this machine. Projects and models can be removed here.
storage.stale: Couldn't refresh just now — showing the last loaded sizes.
storage.cacheHint: Safe to clear — anything needed is regenerated on demand.
storage.clearCacheMessage: Removes regenerable intermediate files from every project. Nothing you made is lost — the next render rebuilds what it needs.
storage.modelsHint: Downloaded model weights are managed in the model library.
storage.failed: Could not measure disk usage — the engine did not answer. Reopen this tab to try again.

remote.heading: Remote engine
remote.hintAfter: on a GPU box, then paste its pairing code here — this laptop becomes the remote control. Projects and renders live with the engine.
remote.pairedUnreachable: Paired with a remote engine (currently unreachable)
remote.allRemote: All generation runs on the remote engine.
remote.disconnectHint: Disconnect to fall back to the local engine.
remote.reviewVerify: Check this matches what the other machine printed before you continue. Anyone who gives you a pairing code chooses the address it connects to.
remote.reviewArmKeys: Also send my provider keys ({keys}) to {host}

engine.heading: This engine
engine.hint: The connection and hardware of the engine rendering your projects.
engine.urlInfo: The local address the app uses to talk to the render engine
engine.backendInfo: The renderer chain the engine tries in order — the first match serves each task
engine.hardwareInfo: Detected GPU and performance tier — this drives model recommendations

backends.heading: Task routing
backends.hintAuto: What renders each step of your video. Routing is automatic: a step runs on a generative backend only while a model for it is installed.
backends.hintManual: What renders each step of your video. Routing is pinned by LOCALCUT_COMFY_KINDS; delete that variable to route from installed models.
backends.unrouted: no backend — this step cannot render
backends.noFfmpeg: Assembly and export need FFmpeg, and none was found on this machine. Install FFmpeg and restart LocalCut AI — until then these steps will fail rather than produce a placeholder video.
backends.stillClips: {name} — still images with motion applied; install a video model for true motion

kindInfo.script: Writes the screenplay — your idea becomes narrated scenes
kindInfo.keyframe: Generates the still image that defines each scene's look
kindInfo.thumbnail: Small preview images for scene tiles and project cards
kindInfo.clip: Animates each scene's keyframe into a moving video clip
kindInfo.narration: Speaks the story aloud with text-to-speech
kindInfo.captions: Times the spoken words for subtitles
kindInfo.timeline: Cuts clips, narration, captions and music into one edit

setup.heading: Setup
setup.hint: Run the first-launch hardware check and recommended model picks again.

about.hint: The "what version are you on?" answer, one copy away.
about.diagnosticsHint: Copies versions, tier, GPU and memory as plain text for bug reports.
about.licensesIntro: LocalCut AI is built with these open-source packages. Each remains under its own license, held by its respective authors.
